events.title: Saanich Lifesaving Camp
events.description: Runs Fridays, 5 sessions. The Saanich Lifesaving Camp is a fun and active program for youth who are interested in becoming future lifeguards or wanting to refresh their lifesaving skills. This includes developing swimming skills, safety in and around aquatic environments. Learn basic first aid and try exciting rescue simulation activities. Through games, teamwork, and hands-on challenges, participants will develop water safety knowledge and leadership skills in a supportive environment that will help them in their future aquatic lifesaving endeavors. Pre-requisites: Must be between 10 – 14 years of age. Must be able to swim 50 meters independently.

******

Check out the Jumpstart Multi Sport Court at Panorama! Free, accessible, recreational play for all ages. 

Space includes 8 basketball nets (2 adjustable), a convertible net (set to high or low height dependent on the day), picnic tables and a free play space. Sun shades are hung seasonally. Lines and nets are recreational; not regulation.

Bring or borrow equipment. Equipment may be signed out at Reception (available first come, first served).

Please limit play to 30 minutes if others are waiting. 

Code of Conduct:  Users are expected to be welcoming, inclusive and sportsmanlike. Panorama Recreation promotes a safe, welcoming, positive and inclusive environment where everyone is valued and respected. Staff, volunteers, participants and facility users are expected to be considerate, respectful of others, and take proper care for our facility and equipment.

Staff, volunteers, participants and facility users are expected to be considerate, respectful of others, and take proper care for our facility and equipment.

events.title: Buddhist Meditation *Hybrid Drop-in
events.description:
Introduction to Buddhist Meditation (Sep15-Oct 27)  *Hybrid Drop-in ($15 per class)
Instructor: Canadian Buddhist Monk, Gen Kelsang Zopa
In today’s fast-paced and often overwhelming world, finding a sense of inner peace and refuge can feel out of reach. Learning how to develop and maintain a peaceful mind is the very essence of Buddhist meditation. We discover that both happiness and suffering mainly arise from our mental habits, and learn to experience the healing insights of Buddhist meditation in our daily life.

Buddhist Meditation for a Loving Heart (Nov 3-Dec 15) *Hybrid Drop-in ($15 per class)
Instructor: Canadian Buddhist Monk, Gen Kelsang Zopa
We all long for more positive and joyful relationships with others, free of tension and stress. In this course we will explore Buddha’s teachings on how to develop a patient, kind and accepting attitude towards everyone we meet. By letting go of our tendency to see faults in others and developing equanimity, we will find meaning and joy in all our relationships.

This group is  a fun and relaxed opportunity to learn different sports and social skills in an environment that welcomes young adults of all levels of functioning ability. Previous experience with sports is not required. This program focusses on enjoyable skill games based on floor hockey, basketball, pickleball and group games tailored to each person’s abilities.

Players and volunteers all enjoy the accepting and encouraging atmosphere. The lead volunteers are themselves people who have overcome physical challenges to find success in sports and in life. The improved physical activity, coordination, and cooperation skills gained in the gym transfer to greater success in other activities at home and in the community. Each participant is recognized for their best moment in every session. Each individual success is an opportunity for a group celebration. 

Come join us for weekly drop in!

Players of all skill levels who are comfortable with fundamental skills and basics of volleyball are welcome. Each session consists of three 25-minute games, allowing players opportunity to compete against different teams. All equipment provided.

Waitlist:  If you waitlist and a space becomes available, you will be notified by email. You will be asked to accept or decline the space. Please do so in a timely manner so those subsequently waitlisted may have opportunity to fill the space if you no longer want it. 

Refund/Cancellation:  Full refund for cancellations made with more than 24 hours' notice. Cancel your session online via your account. No refund for cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice. No-shows will be charged.

Code of Conduct:  Players are expected to be welcoming, inclusive and sportsmanlike. Panorama Recreation promotes a safe, welcoming, positive and inclusive environment where everyone is valued and respected. Staff, volunteers, participants and facility users are expected to be considerate, respectful of others, and take proper care for our facility and equipment.

Party Fee Information:
~ Includes admission for up to 15 children and five adults
~ Children under 7 must be within arms reach of an adult (16+) at a 1:3 ratio in pool
~ Children 7-9 must have a responsible adult in the facility
~ Rental includes tables and chairs set up in party room
~ Rental insurance is required for a fee ranging $4-13. Visit crd.instantriskcoverage.com for purchase, select Birthday Party as the activity.

events.title: Play Beyond Expectations
events.description:
Run by Lifetime Networks - Play Beyond Expectations provides adults with developmental disabilities an opportunity to access inclusive, community-based recreation in an open gym format. This group is  a fun and relaxed opportunity to learn different sports and social skills in an environment that welcomes young adults of all levels of functioning ability. Previous experience with sports is not required. This program focusses on enjoyable skill games based on floor hockey, basketball, pickleball and group games tailored to each person’s abilities.

Players and volunteers all enjoy the accepting and encouraging atmosphere. The lead volunteers are themselves people who have overcome physical challenges to find success in sports and in life. The improved physical activity, coordination, and cooperation skills gained in the gym transfer to greater success in other activities at home and in the community. Each participant is recognized for their best moment in every session. Each individual success is an opportunity for a group celebration. 

Come join us for weekly drop in!

events.description:
Each party includes one hour of your chosen activity, followed by one hour in the party room. The room is available 15 minutes prior to start time for set up. Please note that we must receive 10 days notice to cancel a booking to receive a full refund. Additional pool party time slots may be available on weekends. Please contact reception for details. 

Party Fee Information:
~ Includes admission for up to 15 children and five adults
~ Children under 7 must be within arms reach of an adult (16+) at a 1:3 ratio in pool
~ Children 7-9 must have a responsible adult in the facility
~ Rental includes tables and chairs set up in party room
~ Rental insurance is required for a fee ranging $4-13. Visit crd.instantriskcoverage.com for purchase, select Birthday Party as the activity.

events.title: Victoria Pride Skate
events.description:
🌈 Join us for the Victoria Pride Skate – a community building event for 2SLGBTQIA+ people and allies! Lace up your skates and glide into an afternoon of inclusivity, recreation and fun!

📅 Sunday December 20
🕑 2 - 4 p.m. (Gates open at 1:30 p.m.)
📍 Save-On-Foods Memorial Centre (Gate #3, 1925 Blanshard St, Victoria)

Advanced registration only (no drop-ins). Limited spaces available, so secure your spot today!

Ice Skate Rentals:
Our Skate shop will be open and available for skate and helmet rentals. Ice skate rentals are $4.44 per person and helmets are free, payment can be made by cash, debit or credit. 

Accessibility and Safety:
Attendees will enter Save-On-Foods Memorial Centre at Gate #3, this entrance is wheelchair accessible. Washrooms for this event are gender-inclusive and wheelchair accessible. We’ll have a limited number of ice skating supports available for those who need, plus a sensory inclusion room for anyone looking for a quieter space. 

Parking:
The Save on Foods Memorial Centre parking lot is a paid lot located at 1925 Blanshard Ave (access off Pembroke Street). Scan one of the Indigo QR codes located throughout the parking lot. Enter your license plate and payment information on your mobile device.

events.description: Step into the extraordinary realm of Minecraft and unlock the wonders of engineering with your team. Build, craft, and complete challenges using teamwork and ingenuity! After lunch, unleash your engineering prowess with our LEGO Crazy Contraptions kits. Get ready for a day filled with creativity, teamwork, and unforgettable fun!

events.title: Saanich Lifesaving Pro-D-Day Camp
events.description: The Saanich Lifesaving Camp is a fun and active program for youth who are interested in becoming future lifeguards or wanting to refresh their lifesaving skills. This includes developing swimming skills, safety in and around aquatic environments. Learn basic first aid and try exciting rescue simulation activities. Through games, teamwork, and hands-on challenges, participants will develop water safety knowledge and leadership skills in a supportive environment that will help them in their future aquatic lifesaving endeavors. Pre-requisites: Must be between 10 – 14 years of age. Must be able to swim 50 meters independently.

events.title: LEGO Robotics (Spike Essential) and Science - Gorilla Battlebots Ed!
events.description: Join our LITTLUNIVERSE for LEGO, programming & science! Teammates will dive into engineering using LEGO’s Spike Essential Sets/Software! Build/program Battlebots! Take-home science experiments! Indoor/outdoor activities! Game consoles! Air hockey! Foosball! Arts/Crafts! Camp T-shirt! & MORE!

events.title: Pottery Pro D Day Camp
events.description: A fun half-day of crafting and sculpting with clay! Participants will get to use their imaginations to build and small projects which will be fired and ready for pickup about 2 weeks after the class is completed. Other crafts and games will complement studio time. All materials included.

events.title: Pro-D Baseball Camp
events.description: Gloves up and get ready to play! This fun, active baseball camp welcomes players of all skill levels. Kids will build confidence while working on throwing, catching, hitting, fielding, base running and game fundamentals through stations, challenges, relays and scrimmages. Whether brand new to baseball or already playing, the focus is on learning, teamwork, sportsmanship and, most importantly, having fun! Equipment provided, but please bring your own if you have it.

events.title: Inclusion Program Spring Break 2027 Intake - Week 1
events.venue_name: All locations where camps take place
events.description: This is the Saanich Inclusion Program services intake for requests for Spring Break 2027. This program supports campers aged 5-12 years old. As program capacity is contingent on Island Health funding and staffing levels, we currently have a small number of supported inclusion spaces. We hope to have the ability to add more campers in the future if possible. To best support this process, please add your name to the waitlist if your desired week is full - as things always change. You will be notified as soon as possible if spaces open up. We encourage all families on the waitlist to continue to explore the care options that best support their family, in the event that our program capacity is reached.

events.title: Spring Break Adventures Camp 9-12yrs
events.description: Join us for a week of your FAVOURITE games and camp activities! We'll get outdoors, play in the gym, and go swimming too!

events.title: Spring Break Camp 5-12yrs
events.description: Let our qualified and energetic leaders keep your child active over the Spring Break holiday. Themed activities, crafts, and games will make for a jam-packed week! Camp includes swimming.

events.title: Spring Break Camp 5-8yrs
events.description: Let our qualified and energetic leaders keep your child active over the Spring Break holiday. Sports, crafts, games, swimming, and adventures will make for a jam-packed week! For children currently in Kindergarten through Grade 3.

events.title: Lil' Scientists
events.description: This week is packed full of science games and experiments for young curious scientists. We'll mix, measure and stir our way through chemical reactions, experiments with colour and try our hand at some Kitchen 'magic'! Active games and an out-trip are also included in this week's activities. Children must be currently in kindergarten or higher to register.

events.title: Outdoor Adventures
events.description: Looking for a challenge? This rewarding camp is all about hills and hikes. Ascend Mt. Doug, check out Mt. Tolmie and Mystic Vale, all while having fun and playing games. All the regular fun of camp like active games and crafts will be included.

events.title: Spring Break - Acorns Camp
events.description: Looking for a fun way to spend Spring Break? Join us at Acorns Camp for a variety of exciting activities and opportunities to make new friends! Campers can look forward to walking trips, swim days, arts and crafts, outdoor games, and plenty of fun throughout the day! For children currently in Kindergarten.

events.title: Spring Break - Oaks Camp
events.description: Get ready for a Spring Break full of fun, creativity, and adventure at Spring Break Oaks Camp! Campers will enjoy a variety of activities throughout the week, from arts and crafts and outdoor games to walking trips, swim days, and more. Every day brings something new to enjoy!

events.title: Spring in the Parks - Into the Wild
events.description: This camp is Wild! Go on an adventure each day with a different theme to learn about wild animals. You will be bugging out and enjoying a shark - tastic day. There will be a little bit of learning and a whole lot of animal adventures every day!

events.title: Nhl Spring Break Ice Hockey Camp (5-8 yrs)
events.description: Recreation Oak Bay's popular and well-established Novice Hockey League (NHL) is proud to present its Spring Camp. This active half day camps for boys and girls offers 6 hours of on-ice hockey instruction. Skills covered for beginner to intermediate level players are skating, stick handling, passing, shooting and team play. Station centered drills in like-skilled groups are utilized to keep kids moving and engaged at a challenging level. Off-ice activities include fun on the indoor turf playing cooperative games. Goalies in full CSA certified gear are welcome. Full gear is mandatory for all players. Players must be able to skate the length of the ice with some speed and stop comfortably. Must have completed Preschool Level 3 or Skate 2.

events.title: Nhl Spring Break Ice Hockey Camp (8 -14Yrs)
events.description: Recreation Oak Bay's popular and well-established Novice Hockey League (NHL) is proud to present its Spring Camp. This active half day camp for boys and girls offers 6 hours of on-ice hockey instruction. Skills covered for beginner to intermediate level players are skating, stick handling, passing, shooting and team play. Station centered drills in like-skilled groups are utilized to keep kids moving and engaged at a challenging level. Off-ice activities include fun on the indoor turf playing cooperative games. Goalies in full CSA certified gear are welcome. Full gear is mandatory for all players. Players must be able to skate the length of the ice and back with some speed and stop comfortably. Must have completed preschool 3 or skate 2.

events.title: Outdoor Explorers 8-11
events.description: Perfect for those who enjoy diversity. This camp wonderful combination of lively crafts, thrilling games, and an exciting outing every week!

events.title: Spring Adventurers
events.description: Join us at Centennial Park for a spring break camp focused on connecting with nature. Kids will engage in themed activities, arts and crafts, forest exploration, and group games, all designed to inspire creativity and curiosity. Open to children who are in kindergarten.

events.title: Spring Seekers K-7
events.description: Ideal for those who love variety; a mix of vibrant crafts, exciting games, and an adventurous outing each week! We warmly welcome 5-year-olds currently in Kindergarten to join the fun.

events.title: SNPP - Spring Break Camp! 5-10yrs
events.description: A safe, high quality, and affordable day camp program, delivered in community park and playground settings. Our staff are experienced, enthusiastic, and fully trained for any scenario. Let your child's spring break come alive through active and imaginative play, creative adventures, and unstructured outdoor fun. This program runs rain or shine, so come ready for the great outdoors! IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ 1. This program runs rain or shine. We will be playing outside for the entire day. Children enrolled this program are best set up for success when they attend with weather appropriate clothing. This means rain boots, muddy buddy or rain pants & rain coat, a warm hat, umbrella, extra socks, extra pants and shirts etc. What to bring: Backpack with the above clothing listed, lunch plus 2 snac

events.title: Junior Lifeguard Camp
events.description: In Junior Lifeguard Camp, kids learn attitudes and skills that could one day save a life – their life, or someone else’s! This camp is designed to let kids simulate real lifeguards in a safe, fun and controlled setting. Campers will enjoy friendly competition and special events, challenging themselves to aim for personal bests, and learn about lifesaving and lifeguarding while hanging out with friends. Pre-requisite: Campers must have passed Oak Bay Swim Level 4 or equivalent to register.

events.title: Art and Clay Camp 6-9yrs
events.description: Create with clay for half the day and dig into drawing, painting, collage and more for the best of both 2D and 3D creative expression. Enjoy a day full of creativity and exploration. Bring your own lunch. Lunchtime care provided

events.title: Badminton Camp 9-13yrs
events.description: Badminton Victoria coaches want to share their love of smashing shuttles with you. Players will learn basic skills, movement and rules of the game to end the week with a fun tournament! All coaches NCCP certified.

events.title: Breakout Adventures - Gordon Head Youth Centre 10-13yrs
events.description: Breakout Adventures has it all! Campers will enjoy local out-trips, sports, group games, skating or swimming, crafting, baking and more! Campers will build friendships and enjoy activities designed for older youth, with more independence, bigger adventures, and nonstop fun. The first and last hour of each camp day is flexible start and end times, in case you want to sleep in or hit the lake early afternoon. We will have open space to hang out, read, or just chill between 9-10am & 3-4pm.

events.title: Camp Chill 9-12yrs
events.description: Spend the morning enjoying outdoor adventures, sports, and games, then slow things down in the afternoon with movies, card games, crafts, and laid‑back hangout time.

events.title: Camp Curtain Call Half Day Musical Theatre Camp 5-7yrs
events.description: Experience the magic of singing, dancing, and acting in this dynamic half-day version of Kaleidoscope's longest running program! Campers will rehearse selections from popular musicals and collaborate to present a fun, high-energy mini-performance for friends and family.

events.title: Camp Wildhood 5.5-8yrs
events.description: Get ready for an unforgettable Spring Break! Our experienced staff provide a fun and safe environment where campers can explore, create and play. Campers will enjoy outdoor adventures, crafts, unstructured free play, and a variety of sports and games. Participants must have completed kindergarten to register.

events.title: Dance and Sing Camp 5.5-9yrs
events.description: For dancers who love to sing and move to the music! In this camp we combine the love of singing with new dance moves. Song favourites such as Disney and Sing and popular musicals will definitely be on the list. A day in this camp includes learning a song, adding moves to it, snack, lunch and performance creations to show parents at the end of the week.

events.title: Drawing Discovery Camp 9-12yrs
events.description: Enjoy expressing your creative ideas and strengthening your drawing skills in this fun week long camp. Explore a wide range of subjects, using pencils, ink, charcoal and pastels.

events.title: Eli Pasquale Basketball Camp - Full Day 8-14yrs
events.description: Enjoy a great basketball experience with Eli Pasquale’s classic program emphasizing skill development and team play. Learn the fundamentals of the game and improve your offensive and defensive skills in a fun-first environment. Camp includes a T-shirt.

events.title: Eli Pasquale Basketball Camp - Half Day 6-9yrs
events.description: Enjoy a great basketball experience with Eli Pasquale’s classic program emphasizing skill development and team play. Learn the fundamentals of the game and improve your offensive and defensive skills in a fun-first environment. Camp includes a T-shirt.

events.title: Engineering: Minecraft Camp- Ocean Adventures 8-12yrs
events.description: Make a splash in Minecraft with this new program! Campers will work in teams to explore and survive the many mysteries of the oceans, all while learning about the real-world efforts to conserve these great bodies of water. Part of the day will include hands-on projects and outside play!

events.title: Falcon Gymnastics - Swing into Spring Camp 5-12yrs
events.description: Our week long camp offers fun and fitness for all levels and ages! Children work and focus on the skills on all events and have the opportunity to learn tumbling, balance beam, vaulting, foam pit, tumble track, bars and many more fun activities. Child must currently be in Kindergarten.

events.title: Falcon Gymnastics - Swing into Spring Camp 5-12yrs
events.description: Our week long camp offers fun and fitness for all levels and ages! Children work and focus on the skills on all events and have the opportunity to learn tumbling, balance beam, vaulting, trampoline, tumble track, bars and many more fun activities. Child must currently be in Kindergarten.

events.title: Forest School Camp 5.5-12yrs
events.description: Forest School is about promoting a deep and lasting connection to the natural world and to each other through purposeful play and exploration. Every day is a different adventure as we follow participants' own interests through nature immersion.

events.title: Kids Cooking Camp 8-12yrs
events.description: If you love to cook or want to learn, this camp is for you. Each day will consist of making snacks and a meal with delicious and creative recipes. Camp also includes skating and outdoor games. All food is provided.

events.title: Kids Cooking Camp 9-12yrs
events.description: If you love to cook or want to learn, this camp is for you. Each day will consist of making snacks and a meal with delicious and creative recipes. Camp also includes swimming and outdoor games. All food is provided.

events.title: Kids Jr Cooking Camp 6-8yrs
events.description: Love to cook or want to learn? Each day, prepare a tasty meal using fun and creative recipes. Focus is on hands-on food prep. One delicious meal is provided daily—made by you!

events.title: Lego Robotics and Science Camp - Battlebots Edition 9-15 yrs
events.description: Experience an exciting week filled with LEGO, programming, and science. In small teams, learn engineering with LEGO Mindstorms EV3, culminating in a Battlebots boxing tournament. Science experiments daily, indoor/outdoor activities, game consoles, air hockey, foosball, arts/crafts, board games, and more. Registration includes LITTLUNIVERSE camp t-shirt.

events.title: Little Artists Camp 3-4yrs
events.description: Spring into creativity! This pre-kindergarten camp blends visual arts, music, movement, and storytelling into a vibrant, hands-on experience designed specifically for early learners.

events.title: Musical Theatre - Show Biz Kids Camp 6-8yrs
events.description: Sing, act, and dance your week away as you rehearse a mini musical to share with friends and family on the last day of camp! There will be music, dancing, and lots of fun.

events.title: Paramedic Spring Break Camp 13-17yrs
events.description: Runs Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, 8 sessions. Step into the action this Spring Break! Learn the same lifesaving skills paramedics use, from patient care to emergency response — all taught by certified instructors. Practice real-world scenarios, gear up for a vehicle extraction, and build the teamwork, leadership, and job-ready skills that set you apart. Step up, suit up, and see what it takes to save lives. Included Certifications through the Canadian Red Cross: Standard First Aid & CPR C First Responder

events.title: Spring Break SIVA Volleyball Camp
events.description: A fun and supportive volleyball camp focused on helping young athletes build confidence, improve their skills, and enjoy lots of time on the court over Spring Break. Players will work on the fundamentals of the game through skill development, drills, and gameplay, with an emphasis on having fun, learning, and growing as volleyball players.

events.title: Skate - Power Skating Spring Camp U9-U11
events.description: Keep your kids ' on the edge' of their skills. Maintain all the basics of powerskating including tight turns, stops, pivots, stride and FUN. There will be 2 ice sessions and a dryland session per day. Bring your energy and enthusiasm! Full hockey gear required.

events.title: LEGO Robotics (WeDo 2.0) & Science - Battlebots Ed!
events.description: Join our LITTLUNIVERSE for LEGO, programming and science! Teammates will dive into engineering using LEGO’s WeDO 2.0 Sets/Software! End of week build/program Battlebots! Take-home science experiments! Indoor/outdoor activities! Game consoles! Air hockey! Foosball! Arts/Crafts! Camp T-shirt! & MORE!

events.title: Richardson Sport Multi-Sport Camp (4-6 yrs)
events.description: Welcome to RSI multi sports camp! Our camp focuses on building strong FUNdamentals in a welcoming and playful environment. Kids will learn basic skills in various sports such as soccer, basketball, tee ball, football and much more all while improving their physical literacy, enjoying games and activities designed to spark excitement. It's a perfect mix of learning and fun!

events.title: Pottery Camp
events.description: A fun half day of crafting and sculpting with clay! Participants will get to use their imaginations to build and small projects which will be fired and ready for pickup about 2 weeks after the class is completed. Other crafts and games will complement studio time. All materials included. Please pack a snack and be prepared to go outside during break times.

events.title: Spring Break Baseball Camp
events.description: Gloves up and get ready to play! This fun, active baseball camp welcomes players of all skill levels. Kids will build confidence while working on throwing, catching, hitting, fielding, base running and game fundamentals through stations, challenges, relays and scrimmages. Whether brand new to baseball or already playing, the focus is on learning, teamwork, sportsmanship and, most importantly, having fun! Equipment provided, but please bring your own if you have it.

events.title: Triple Threat Performers Spring Break Program
events.description: Calling all young Broadway lovers! Join Triple Threat Performers for a week of singing, dancing, and acting as students learn an exciting variety of musical theatre numbers, culminating in a special theatre showcase for friends and family. This is a fast paced, engaging course for kids who are looking for a challenge in an encouraging environment. Let your inner star shine!

events.title: Braefoot Spring Break Camp
events.description: Before care 8-9 AM and after care 3-5 PM are available. Register through Braefoot.

events.title: Squash Spring Break Camp 8-11yrs
events.description: This camp is designed to introduce the basic components of the game of squash, while catering to both skill development and fitness. Come ready for fun and to further understand today's rapidly evolving game.

events.title: Squash Camp
events.description: If you love to move, learn and have fun on court, join us for Squash Camp! Each day includes drills, games and match play, giving participants of all skill levels the opportunity to learn and develop squash skills in a positive and supportive environment. All squash skill levels welcome. ****** Eye protection required for juniors and recommended for adults. Eye protection and racquets available for borrow from Reception - or feel free to bring your own!

events.title: Youth Volleyball Camp 10-12yrs
events.description: Build your volleyball skills, confidence and love for the game in this camp! Participants will learn and improve through engaging drills focused on passing, serving, setting and hitting, then have opportunity to put practice into action with game play! Our coaching team includes former college athletes and current high-performance players who bring experience and enthusiasm to every session. All skill levels welcome, from beginners to experienced players looking to improve their game! ****** Please bring running shoes, a lunch, snack and water bottle. Volleyball knee pads are recommended but not required.

events.description: Catch all the soccer excitement this spring! Soccertron is the established leader in providing an organized, total soccer experience. Enthusiastic, professionally trained coaches, really focus on motivating kids and developing strong skill fundamentals. Your child will have a fantastic week. FUN is the most important part of soccer FUNdamentals. Finish each day with a fun swim at the Oak Bay pool. Campers MUST be 7yrs old at the time of the camp to be in accordance with Red Cross regulations when campers are in the pool.

Participants will get to use their imaginations to build and small projects which will be fired and ready for pickup about 2 weeks after the class is completed. Other crafts and games will complement studio time. All materials included. Please pack a snack and be prepared to go outside during break times.

events.title: Tennis Camp - Orange Ball
events.description: Learn the fundamentals of tennis with us! No previous tennis experience required - though registrants should be comfortable with the fundamental movement skills of running, throwing and catching. The Orange Ball Progressive Tennis curriculum will be followed - including with use of modified tennis balls, courts and nets to ensure success and maximize fun. Expect an engaging week of tennis-focused drills and activities, plus match play, along with a sprinkle of general active camp games complementary to tennis.

events.title: Squash Spring Break Camp 12-15yrs
events.description: This camp is designed to further develop the basic squash skills you may already have. Racquet preparation, volley and serve return and friendly competition will be the focus of this camp. Come ready to participate in this fun filled week and further understand today's rapidly evolving game.

events.title: Tennis-Spring Break FUN Camp
events.description: Develop the basics of Tennis in this fun-filled, high energy camp. Cedar Hill Coaches will introduce skill development, team games and point play using the age-based Progressive Tennis system. This camp is appropriate for new or novice players.

events.venue_name: Camp is held on the soccer turf at Tyndall Park.
